title: Flux Kontext adds voxel-art generation
summary:
Flux Kontext brought voxel-art generation, while sign-in got a clearer layout and the community games list gained a time-bending adventure.

Two PRs added `model=kontext` for seed-tier users, supporting text-to-image generation and image-to-image generation from a supplied image URL. Outputs are capped at 640 pixels on the longest side. GPT Image was also marked as requiring the flower tier.

The auth page gained a responsive layout, a redesigned login button, and a GitHub profile badge for signed-in users. Token-validation caching was added to reduce repeated database lookups.

RETIME - FABRIC OF REALITY joined the community games list. The Pollinations-powered text adventure has screen-reader accessibility, story-shaping choices, and time-based mechanics.

highlights.title: Flux Kontext voxel art
highlights.text: Generate voxel art with `model=kontext` from a prompt or a supplied image URL. Available from the seed tier. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=kontext).
